verdict.rationale: The evidence documents CUDA/HIP/MUSA GPU acceleration and CPU+GPU hybrid offloading for models larger than VRAM (llama-cpp-gh-9, llama-cpp-gh-10, llama-cpp-comm-11), but none of it describes distributing inference across multiple GPUs via tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism specifically. Missing for 10: any mention of multi-GPU tensor-split, pipeline parallelism, or data-parallel inference modes, and any benchmark/community report of running across 2+ GPUs.
